jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - part-time or weekend work
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

Team/division description:
 

Lexus, One Omnichannel Experience (Lexus, OCX) is the Function that is the promoting the LEXUS brand 360 degree and delivers one seamless omnichannel experience across physical and digital touchpoints. The Function brings under one roof Divisions such as Lexus Brand, Digital Experience & E-Commerce, Data Platforms & Customer Engagement Management (CEM), Customer Relations, Strategy & Performance, and One Academy. Its mission is to define and connect every customer touchpoint across the ONE TOYOTA Ecosystem in an omnichannel way to drive conversion, loyalty and monetisation. AI based automation and self-services are unlocking cost efficiencies, while a system of actionable insights is leading to continuous performance improvements. A unified, centrally governed and legally compliant data foundation is the key enabler for building long term trusted relationships with our customers.
 

Due to its multiple impact across the business, the function should collaborate seamlessly with other TME functions and NMSCs as the primary implementer.
 

Your task: 
 

 
• Agenda, Mailbox, Expense & Travel Management: Manage the Function Head’s agenda, mailbox, travel booking, and expenses.
 
• Team Travel & Expenses: Support team Heads with travel and expenses upon request.
 
• Travel Coordination: Share travel-related information across the function.
 
• All Team meeting organization: Organize Quarterly All Team meeting – book venue, collect and consolidate presentations from each team, present team related content.
 
• Weekly Direct reports meeting / Bi-Weekly Lexus Team Meeting: set-up meeting (including meeting room), consolidate PowerPoint presentation for the meetings, create midterm agenda visibility.
 
• Off-site Meetings: Coordinate logistics, including hotels, catering, venues, and registration.
 
• Events: Organise Christmas parties and team-building activities.
 
• Mailing Lists & Org Charts: Keep mailing groups and organisation charts up to date.
 
• Office Management: Coordinate daily office operations, meeting rooms, and group calendars.
 
• (Oracle Finance system) PR/PO & Supplier Creation: Create PR/Pos when needed (such as special office supply ordering, Teambuilding down payment)
 
• Facilities: Coordinate facility matters, locker lists, and Kara-Kara clean-up activities.
 
• Ad-hoc Support: Support team members with ad-hoc requests.
 
• One Team Sprit: Support the leadership team in building a One Team Sprit considering the diversity of the divisions. 

Your profile:
 

 
• Reliable, Accurate & Proactive: Attention to detail, highly precise, strong organisational skills.
 
• Persistent, Stress-resistant & Hard-working: Focused and resilient in a demanding environment.
 
• Team Player and Independent Worker: Collaborates well and manages tasks independently.
 
• Multicultural Communication: Communicates effectively in diverse environments.
 
• Results-driven: Turns objectives into clear, tangible actions.
 
• Communication and Presentation Skills: Communicates clearly and professionally.
 
• Planning and Organisation: Manages priorities and multiple tasks efficiently.
 
• Discreet: Handles confidential information professionally and with high integrity.
 
• Microsoft Office Skills: Good knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams.
 
• Fluent in English: Other languages are an asset.

SAS Global (Scientific Allied Solutions) is an independent partner in animal health, specialising in veterinary diagnostics, autogenous vaccines and contract research. With various subsidiaries and our head office in Belgium, and an international presence across Europe, Asia, Jordan and Brazil, we support vets, farmers and pharmaceutical companies with innovative solutions for healthier animals and more efficient production.
 

To support the continued growth of our three Brazilian subsidiaries, we are seeking an enterprising Regional Manager.
 

What does the role involve?
 

Location: Paulínia, São Paulo, Brazil 

Reports to: Global Management Team 
 

As Regional Manager Brazil, you will act as the link between our Belgian organisation and our branches in Brazil. You will manage the day-to-day operations of one branch, support its further development and foster collaboration between the various companies.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

• You will manage the day-to-day operations and further development of one of our Brazilian branches 

• You will optimise processes and coordinate production, quality, logistics and administration. 

• You will lead the local team and monitor budgets, KPIs and results. 

• You act as the link between the Brazilian branches and the Belgian organisation. 

• You foster collaboration and implement group-wide strategies and procedures. 

• You oversee strategic projects and support growth and investment initiatives. 

• You contribute to the long-term strategy for Brazil. 

• You build lasting relationships with customers, partners and government bodies. 
 

• You 
hold a master’s degree or have equivalent experience. 

• You have at least five years’ management experience in an international environment. 

• Experience in setting up or further developing an organisation is a significant asset. 

• You combine strong organisational and communication skills with a hands-on approach and strategic insight. 

• You are an inspiring leader who knows how to bring people together and take responsibility 

• You work independently and take the initiative 

• You communicate fluently in Portuguese and English; knowledge of Dutch is an advantage.

Team/division description:
 

You will be working for the Human Resources division, called People & Innovation. You will be part of the Data Analytics and HR Solutions team (part of Business Innovation within P&I). Our main purpose is to ensure HR data is accurate, governed, business-relevant, and transformed into trusted analytics and reporting solutions by acting as the primary bridge between HR business stakeholders, IT data teams, and reporting developers.
 

At P&I we strive to deliver effective solutions towards business leaders and our Pan-E regional HR counterparts. Listening to the customer is essential to developing adequate and efficient solutions.
 

Your responsibilities
 

Your role is to support building foundation and contribute to strong employee experiences.
 

 
• HR Data Governance & Data Quality
 
• Business Analysis within HR Data Domain
 
• Bridge between HR and ITD Data Product Delivery Team
 
• Overview Snowflake operations (catalogue, ingest, semantic modelling design)
 
• Managing Power BI Reporting Portfolio (prioritisation and budget control)
 
• Stakeholder Management (withing HR areas and business)
 
• Monitoring testing and release management
 
• Ensure compliance, privacy & security rules are followed 

Your profile:
 

Your profile:
 

 
• English (Professional/Business Fluency), other languages are also an asset.
 
• Experience with Snowflake, Collibra and Data Product creation is essential for this role
 
• Knowledge of SQL, Qlick, Power BI is an asset
 
• Stakeholder Management
 
• Able to work with HR executives, HR operations teams, Data engineers, Solution architects, BI developers, Vendors
 
• Strong ability to simplify complex concepts, create executive summaries, present risks and recommendations.
 
• Our ideal candidate can facilitate workshops, and liaise with multinational teams
 
• The ideal candidate has a natural interest in the customer voice. They have proven similar past experiences, in the field of data governance, analytics, AI solutions design.
 
• Must be able to challenge assumptions, connect data across systems, identify root causes, spot inconsistencies.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service | Czech + English + Eastern-European Language
jobs.description:
Are you a born problem solver with a passion for customer satisfaction? Do you want to work in an international environment where no day is the same? Then we have the perfect challenge for you! At Volvo, they are looking for an enthusiastic customer service representative to join their Central-East team and contribute to their mission of getting vehicles back on the road quickly and efficiently. Your duties: 

 
• Provide first line support for international breakdowns: Wherever our customers are in Europe, you will be there to help them and address their concerns. 
 

 
• Maintain regular contact with dealers and customers: So that everyone is always informed about the progress of repairs. 
 

 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support. 
 Keywords: customer support advisor, customer service, call agent, customer service representative

Bachelor thinking level. Fluent in English + Czech + one of following: Polish, Lithuanian, German (minimum B2 level). 

Flexible in working hours: Working in a full-time system is not a problem for you; rather, you enjoy the variety. 

Driving license B: You must be able to come to the company independently.

jobs.occupation: Inside sales | Portuguese market | 100% onsite in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Are you a commercially driven professional who thrives on building relationships and closing deals? We are looking for an ambitious Inside Sales Representative to drive business development, generate new opportunities, and strengthen customer relationships across the Portuguese market.

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a well-established international company operating within the food sector. With a family-business mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and strong growth ambitions, they offer a fast-paced environment where initiative and results are highly valued.

 

Omschrijving

• Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities within the Portuguese market.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals.
• Conduct commercial negotiations and follow up on sales opportunities.
• Expand the customer portfolio and strengthen market presence.
• Analyze sales performance and market trends.
• Report on sales activities and contribute to the overall sales strategy.
 

• Fluent in Portuguese and English, knowledge of Dutch or additional languages is a strong asset
• Previous experience in sales, business development, or a commercial role.
• Strong commercial acumen and a results-oriented mindset.
• A true go-getter with the drive to open new doors and create opportunities.
• Confident communicator with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Affinity with the food industry is an advantage.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.

Do you like to work in the heart of Gent city? We're looking for you!

Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you will work in an inspiring, high-paced and fun environment. We work on software projects according to the agile methodology (SCRUM) and in close collaboration with our customers.
Role
As a Java developer your input will help shape the future of the company, we will count on you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects. You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to learn more.

Profile
• You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in any of the following technologies: Java, Spring Boot framework, NodeJS, designing and implementing RESTful API’s

• Also interested in frontend development? We work mostly with Angular, React and React Native.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Azure or AWS is a plus

• You are able to help set up the architecture for our projects, selecting the right technologies to serve the business need and review UI designs

• You are willing to develop yourself and learn new technologies

• You are fluent in English + Dutch or French is a must.

Ready to kick-start your logistics career? On behalf of our client Katoen Natie, we're seeking motivated Order Pickers / Warehouse Employees for their dynamic operations in Gent Zeehaven. This is a temporary contract with excellent potential for permanent employment - your chance to prove yourself while learning from industry experts.

As an order picker, you'll be a crucial link in the international logistics chain, handling valuable materials and ensuring smooth operations for clients worldwide. This versatile role offers the perfect opportunity to develop your skills in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

• 

• YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Order Picking: Accurately collect goods from warehouse locations using picking lists and handheld scanners

Quality Control: Inspect items for damage and ensure correct quantities before processing

Packing & Preparation: Prepare orders for shipping, including proper packaging and labeling

Receiving: Unload deliveries, check incoming goods, and update inventory systems

Inventory Management: Organize stock locations and maintain warehouse cleanliness

Safety Compliance: Follow all safety protocols and maintain a secure working environment

Team Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across different shifts

Continuous Improvement: Suggest ways to optimize processes and increase efficiency

• Essential Requirements:
Basic logistics experience (warehouse, order picking, packing, production) OR strong willingness to learn

Enthusiastic attitude combined with a hands-on mentality - ready to roll up your sleeves!

Reliability and punctuality - your team depends on you

Eye for detail and quality - accuracy is crucial in our operations

Physical fitness - comfortable standing, walking, and lifting throughout your shift

Availability for 2-shift system (early and late shifts)

Basic Dutch or English communication skills

What Makes You Stand Out:

Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or scanning equipment

Forklift or reach truck certification (or willingness to obtain)

Previous experience in international logistics or port operations

Multilingual skills for our diverse, international workplace

Positive team player attitude with problem-solving mindset
